destination.name: Artis Aquarium (Aquariumgebouw)
destination.note: The backlog row said 'Plantage Kerklaan'; Wikipedia gives Plantage Middenlaan 53. The pand is not in artis-entrance (0363100012181131, 0363100012181128), groote-museum (0363100012165614) or artis-library (0363100012164975); no landmarks.json POI is named Aquarium (only Artis descriptions mention it). BAG bouwjaar 1746 on this pand is a registry value for an older element, the building dates from 1881-82.

facts: Rijksmonument at Plantage Middenlaan 53, built 1881 (opened 1882) by architect G.B. Salm, with his son Abraham.
Neoclassical facade with an enormous stair, columns and a dome; the dome on the east side served as a lecture hall and later held the Heiman diorama of Texel.

The building is divided lengthwise: professors' rooms, lecture hall and museum space on the street side, aquaria on the garden side; 1740 wooden piles carry the tanks; cellars hold gravel and sand filter reservoirs.
Restored 2021-2025; reopened to the public 13 June 2026.

measuredBy.3dbag: NL.IMBAG.Pand.0363100012170226 LoD2.2, ground 0.721 m NAP, 133-vertex ring about 88 m long on a 209.5 degree front: wings eave 9.1 m, pavilions 11.4-12.6 m, pediment gable behind the portico 13.4-16.8 m (symmetry axis u = -5.3 m); rounded dome ends to the east and west. The BAG ring and 3DBAG shell do not include the portico (columns, platform, stairs), which is modelled in front of the shell gable.
measuredBy.photoMeasurements: Portico width 16.2 m from the gable; coupled column pairs 1.3 m apart at each corner, 10.5 m clear central bay with two portals; column height about 7.3 m on a 3.3 m rusticated platform; five-bay wings (blind, three windows, blind) and two six-metre pavilions with paired arched windows, all counted from ref-front-wide.jpg and ref-street-portico.jpg.
uncertain: Rounded east (dome) and west ends and the garden side have no street photograph (inferred plain shell).
Stone colours are tuned flat tones; the weathered facade is greyer and more brown than the model, and the wing arcade relief is simplified.
Number of return columns on each side of the portico and basement details were read from one oblique photograph.
